run_geometry_optimization: run a geometry optimization job on an atomic structure using an ASE calculator and optimization parameters
calculate_single_point_energy: calculate the single-point energy and forces for a given atomic structure using an ASE calculator
run_conformer_energies: run geometry optimizations on molecular conformers and return initial and final energy and force results
calculate_protonation_energies: calculate protonation state energies and geometries for molecules across different protonation states
calculate_spin_gap: calculate unoptimized spin gap energies by performing single-point calculations on structures at different spin states
